name: Marching Cubes Surface Normal Estimation
aliases: Gradient-based Normal Estimation for Marching Cubes
Marching Cubes Surface Normal Estimation — Central Difference Normal for MC, Gradient-based Normal Estimation for Marching Cubes
definition: Computes surface normals for the extracted isosurface mesh by approximating the gradient of the underlying scalar field using central differences, then normalizing the result.
summary: Marching Cubes Surface Normal Estimation computes normals by approximating the scalar field gradient via central differences, yielding smoother results than geometric averaging.
